diagnostics.message: Imports "cProfile" but it's not declared in requirements files, pyproject.toml, or Pipfile and isn't Python stdlib
diagnostics.help: Most often this is an LLM hallucinating a plausible-sounding package name. Either add the package to your manifest, or correct the import. If your runtime provides it, list it under imports.provided in .aislop/config.yml.

scoreImpact.rationale: Imports missing from the manifest are high-confidence install/runtime failures.

diagnostics.message: Meta/plan comment (before/after state narration)
diagnostics.help: Remove — references to the build plan or before/after code state belong in PR descriptions and commit messages, not source.

scoreImpact.rationale: Process narration is cleanup noise and should not make a healthy repo look broken.

diagnostics.message: The null-forgiving `!` silences the nullable warning without proving the value is non-null.
diagnostics.help: Handle the null case (guard, `??`, or throw with context) instead of asserting non-null. Use `!` only when non-null is provable, and say why.

scoreImpact.rationale: The null-forgiving ! silences nullable safety without proving the value is non-null.

diagnostics.message: XML-doc summary restates the member name without adding information.
diagnostics.help: Delete the doc comment, or replace boilerplate ("Gets or sets the X") with the *why*: constraints, units, invariants a reader can't infer from the signature.

scoreImpact.rationale: XML-doc that restates the member name is a cleanup/style finding, not a defect.
